escalation_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
text: For National Highways NH roads the responsible authority is NHAI National Highways Authority of India, complaints should be filed at Rajmargyatra portal rajmargyatra.nhai.org or call helpline 1033, grievance email grievances@nhai.org, escalate to Ministry of Road Transport MoRTH if unresolved, response expected within 30 days

For State Highways SH roads the responsible authority is State PWD Public Works Department, file complaints at pgportal.gov.in or state-specific portal, contact state Chief Engineer PWD for escalation, response expected within 45 days, for Telangana state highways contact Roads and Buildings Department

For Major District Roads MDR the responsible authority is the District Collector Office, contact the District Collector or District Magistrate office, escalate to State PWD Regional Office if needed, response expected within 60 days, file at pgportal.gov.in

For rural PMGSY roads the responsible authority is NRIDA National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency, use Meri Sadak app to file complaints or visit omms.nic.in, email helpdesk@pmgsy.nic.in, escalate to State Rural Roads Development Agency, response within 60 days

For city roads and municipal roads the responsible authority is the Municipal Corporation or Urban Local Body, for Hyderabad contact GHMC Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation at 040-21111111, for Bengaluru contact BBMP, response expected within 21 days which is shorter than highways
